summary: 本次是对 review_artifacts/runtime_self_test_invocation_code_design.md 在 SHA-256 38d8297f…81a9 处的独立外部内容审阅。前一候选（629f2159…）的零 finding 结论未被继承，十八项要求全部按本次精确字节重新逐条评估。本轮唯一的主题变更在「Hash and evidence closure」：第 292-296 行现在把先决条件绑定为已独立审阅并批准的修订版 Execution basis `f562700d97c6432dc97840a99a6c238633e15534a88ada5a18e3b027627d1ed7` 及其 superseding owner decision `d84a74ece9cb6d574b050c484d76263b061c8c7cc8946c68c43e99d2ee5b1388`（后者比上一版补齐了 owner decision 的 SHA-256）。第 3-288 行的调用流、接口、错误、模块、Slice、测试、codec 与迁移语义逐行核对后未变：十条 primary-flow 边（66-75）各自只带一个 interface_id 或 error_code 并唯一落到 77-116 / 118-159 的契约行；五个接口各有精确输入与成功输出；六个错误各有唯一 owner、触发、含义与调用方动作；六个模块 required_tests 合计 24 个互不重复的测试 id，三个 Slice（236、244、251）恰好是其所含模块的并集，无新增无遗漏；每个 excluded surface 都有且只有一个后继 owning_slice_id 与 gate（233-235、243），且该 surface 出现在被指名 Slice 的 included_surfaces（240、248）。关于修订版 Execution 的 test_resource_factory：它是 Execution 侧 inline helper 的一个可选 keyword-only 参数，其附加资源以 description/live object 形式进入 Execution 自有的 RuntimeTestExecutionBinding.resource_bindings；本 Invocation 主题只接收成对的 test_execution_binding_ref/sha256（255-256），回调 `validate_test_execution_boundary` 返回 None 且『returns no peer record and creates no Invocation-to-Execution import』（99），测试操作只按既有的 capability/resource/action ID 字段寻址（258），具体 repository/command/SQL session 仍属 Verification later work（266、283、191）。因此该修订未在 Invocation 侧新增任何字段或行为，交接面（Execution 基线第 343-344、409-427 行）与主题声明一致。三个 owning Design 的 hash（36、40、44）与所供 Execution 基线第 77、81、85 行一致，plan hash（291）与所供计划、owner decision 第 9 行一致。十八项要求全部 satisfied，零 finding。本报告仅为外部内容审阅，不构成实现批准、已注册 Runtime 审阅、精确提交工程评审或发布准入。

requirements.requirement: the intended result is testable and all affected responsibilities have one clear owner;
requirements.evidence: requested_result (30-33) states one bounded outcome ('Let the existing provider-neutral Invocation path consume an exact Runtime self-test boundary without any production authorization context, decision, entitlement or grant') and is made checkable by fifteen acceptance_criteria (272-285) plus three executable slice completion gates (237, 245, 252). Ownership is single-valued everywhere: six logical modules each declare one responsibility (161, 172, 183, 194, 205, 216); each of the five interfaces names exactly one owner_module_id (80, 88, 96, 104, 112) and appears in exactly one module's public_interfaces (164, 175, 186, 197, 208); each of the six error codes names exactly one owner_module_id (121, 128, 135, 142, 149, 156); owned_resources are pairwise disjoint (163, 174, 185, 196, 207, 218). Test ownership is exactly once: 168+179+190+201+212+223 hold 6+4+4+5+4+1 = 24 pairwise distinct ids. The peer responsibility has one declared owner at line 217: 'Referenced T2 09 owner validates and admits the exact boundary and operation; implementation remains assigned to the approved Execution basis', reinforced at 272 'Execution-side symbols remain owned by its approved basis.' The refreshed closure does not move any ownership; it only pins the predecessor bytes at 292-296.

requirements.requirement: the primary flow is visible before implementation detail, every handoff edge resolves to one interface contract, every failure edge resolves to one error contract, and every interface defines exact input and successful output;
requirements.evidence: The flow is shown at 9-24 and normatively at 50-75, both before logical_modules (160), implementation_slices (227) and every implementation_bindings row. All ten edges rows (66-75) set exactly one of interface_id or error_code. The five handoff edges resolve one-to-one to interface rows: execute_agent_attempt (77), prepare_registered_invocation_context (85), validate_test_execution_boundary (93), authorize_operation (101), normalize_provider_result (109). The five failure edges resolve one-to-one to error rows: ADAPTER_REQUEST_INVALID (118), RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_INVALID (146), ADAPTER_POLICY_VIOLATION (125), ADAPTER_CONFORMANCE_FAILED (139), ADAPTER_OUTPUT_INVALID (132). Every interface row states exact input and successful output, including the validation-only callback at 98: 'output: None after the host resolves T2 09's committed test binding and verifies the request pair; failure raises the original T2 09 error.' Physical relations stay non-peer via the dotted 'implemented by' relation (57) and generate no edges row.

requirements.evidence: Every module declares responsibility, owned_resources, public_interfaces, allowed_dependencies, prohibited_dependencies, failure_and_recovery, required_tests, future_capabilities, implementation_bindings and disposition (161-226). The 24 required tests are disjoint across modules, so no module's evidence depends on another module's test set, and dependency direction is bounded per module (e.g. 177 prohibits execution_private_state, ambient_filesystem, production_authority_client and provider_transport for invocation_context, matching 91 'Read-only preparation; no provider or resource call'). The two modules in no slice are exactly the two with disposition: retain (215, 226), and their regressions are still assigned to a slice (212 into 244, 223 into 251).

Field absence is fenced structurally, not by denylist: 258, 261, 279 ('exact field-set tests and constructor/call tripwires are positive controls') and 313 ('compare the full dataclass field set, not a denylist'), with the absent expiry bounded at 329-330. Live positive controls exist for every guard: 327-328 'self_test_boundary_admits_provider_transport is the live positive control for both fixed Adapters: the transport counter increments once and returns staged output, usage and trace', owned by provider_executor (201) and present in slice 244; 315-317 pair live resolution with wrong-host/ref/hash rejection and an unchanged external regression; 323-324 proves a base-only external host remains conforming; 334 refuses to let a double stand for real-provider evidence.

requirements.requirement: there is no hidden fallback, parallel authority, or ad hoc bypass; and
requirements.evidence: Fallback is refused in error semantics and module rules: 152 'changed closure requires a new execution and never falls back between boundary kinds', 124 'never infer self-test, fabricate begin/boundary evidence or change provider', 199 prohibits production_authority_minting and implicit_provider_fallback, 267 'Provider/model selection and fallback do not change.' Ad hoc bypass is closed at 265 (neither-evidence rejected before provider), 326-327 ('host_protocol_signature_and_missing_callback fixes the exact method signature and proves a self-test host without it fails before provider entry'), 315-316 (callback bypass rejected before the provider counter changes) and 285.

requirements.requirement: an independent reviewer can compare the future `ChangeSetManifest` with this exact basis.

scope_notes: External CodeDesign content review of one proposed candidate at the stated hash only. It is not implementation approval, registered Runtime review, exact-commit Engineering Review, Design admission or release admission; nothing was edited or approved. The candidate itself remains 'status: proposed' with 'approved_decision_ref: null' (28-29).

The prior zero-finding report on 629f2159… was treated as untrusted evidence and its verdict was not inherited; all eighteen requirements were re-derived from this candidate's bytes. One prior-report count was not reproduced: that report states 27 distinct required tests, whereas this candidate's module lists (168, 179, 190, 201, 212, 223) hold 6+4+4+5+4+1 = 24, matching the slice lists 10+13+1 = 24 exactly. The union property the requirement depends on holds either way; this is a counting difference in the prior report, not a defect in the subject.

No tools were available, so no hash was recomputed. Internal consistency of the refreshed edge was checked against the supplied context headers only: line 294's f562700d…1ed7 matches the supplied Execution basis header, line 296's d84a74ec…b1388 matches the supplied owner decision header, that decision binds the same amended basis bytes (its lines 11-12) and cites review evidence a2d8cc7d…ce87f0 which matches the supplied amendment review header, and line 291's cf0305be…2b576 matches both the supplied plan header and the decision's line 9.

The three owning Design documents (T2 08, T2 09, T2 11) were not supplied. Their hashes at lines 36, 40 and 44 were cross-checked only against the supplied Execution basis's independently stated values at its lines 81, 77 and 85, which agree; referenced-mode meanings were therefore checked for internal consistency and against the peer basis, not against the Design bytes.

Confirmation requested by the task: the amended Execution test_resource_factory creates no new Invocation-owned field or behavior. It is an Execution-side inline-helper parameter whose additional resource descriptions/live objects enter Execution's own RuntimeTestExecutionBinding.resource_bindings. This subject receives only the paired ref/hash (255-256), its callback returns None and 'no peer record' (98-99), test operations address resources through the already-declared capability/resource/action IDs (258), and concrete repository/command/SQL sessions stay Verification-owned later work (191, 266, 283). Nothing in 255-268 or the module map changes as a consequence.
